senses.definition: (sometimes attributive) A situation which poses an immediate risk and which requires urgent attention.
examples: Cardiac arrest is an emergency requiring medical attention.

quotes.text: We also found that the only emergency egress from the tram was by smashing the front or rear windscreens, and that emergency lighting had failed when the tram overturned.
quotes.reference: 2021 December 29, Dominique Louis, “Causal analysis: crashworthiness at Sandilands”, in RAIL, number 947, page 33:

senses.definition: The department of a hospital that treats emergencies.

quotes.text:
I've got a really bad disease
It's got me begging on my hands and knees
So take me to emergency
Cause something seems to be missing
quotes.reference: 2009, “Restless Heart Syndrome”, in 21st Century Breakdown, performed by Green Day:

senses.definition: A person brought in at short notice to replace a member of staff, a player in a sporting team, etc.
examples:
November 2 2014, Daniel Taylor, "Sergio Agüero strike wins derby for Manchester City against 10-man United," guardian.co.uk
Van Gaal responded by replacing Adnan Januzaj with Carrick and, in fairness, the emergency centre-half did exceedingly well given that he has not played since May.

senses.definition: (archaic) The quality of being emergent; sudden or unexpected appearance; an unforeseen occurrence.
(euphemistic) A critical urge to urinate or defecate.
